name: sale_id
description: A unique identifier assigned to each individual sales transaction. This serves as the primary key for the fact table.
business_context: Used to uniquely identify and track every single sale event, enabling granular analysis, auditing, and joining with other sales-related data. Essential for understanding individual transaction details and for data integrity.

name: product_id
description: An identifier that uniquely references a specific product involved in the sale.
business_context: Links the sales record to the `dim_product` table, providing detailed information about the product sold (e.g., name, category, brand, SKU). Critical for analyzing product performance, sales by category, and inventory management.

name: vendor_id
description: An identifier that uniquely references the vendor or supplier of the product sold.
business_context: Links the sales record to the `dim_vendor` table, allowing analysis of sales performance attributed to specific vendors. Useful for vendor management, procurement optimization, and evaluating supplier impact on sales.

name: location_id
description: An identifier that uniquely references the physical or virtual location where the sale transaction occurred.
business_context: Links the sales record to the `dim_location` table (e.g., store, warehouse, region, website). Enables geographical or store-specific sales analysis, understanding regional performance, and optimizing store operations or online fulfillment.

name: channel_id
description: An identifier that uniquely references the sales channel through which the transaction was completed.
business_context: Links the sales record to the `dim_channel` table (e.g., online, in-store, mobile app, call center). Allows for analysis of sales performance across different channels, crucial for multi-channel strategy, channel optimization, and customer journey mapping.

name: date_id
description: The calendar date on which the sales transaction was recorded.
business_context: Used for time-based analysis, enabling aggregation of sales data by day, week, month, quarter, or year. Essential for trend analysis, seasonality detection, period-over-period comparisons, and financial reporting.

name: sale_timestamp
description: The exact date and time when the sales transaction was completed and recorded in the system.
business_context: Provides a precise timestamp for the sale, enabling granular analysis of sales patterns within a day (e.g., peak hours), real-time operational insights, and detailed event sequencing. Useful for fraud detection and understanding transaction flow.

name: quantity_sold
description: The number of units of the product sold in this specific transaction line item.
business_context: Represents the volume of products sold. Used to calculate total units sold, average units per transaction, inventory depletion rates, and is a key metric for demand forecasting and inventory planning.

name: total_sales
description: The gross monetary value generated from this specific sale line item before any discounts, returns, or taxes are applied.
business_context: Represents the total revenue generated from the sale before adjustments. Used for calculating gross revenue, tracking sales targets, and understanding the overall top-line performance of products or channels.

name: margin
description: The profit margin for this specific sale line item, typically calculated as (selling price - cost of goods sold).
business_context: Indicates the profitability of each individual sale. Essential for understanding product profitability, evaluating pricing strategies, assessing the financial health of product categories, and optimizing product assortment.

name: discount
description: The monetary value of any discount applied to this specific sale line item.
business_context: Tracks the financial impact of promotional activities and discounts on sales revenue and profitability. Used to analyze the effectiveness and cost of promotions, and to understand customer price sensitivity.

name: net_amount
description: The final monetary amount received from the customer for this sale line item after applying all discounts but before taxes.
business_context: Represents the actual revenue recognized from the sale after all adjustments. This is a critical metric for calculating net revenue, understanding the true financial intake from each transaction, and for financial reconciliation.

name: created_at
description: The timestamp indicating when this specific sales record was first created and ingested into the data system.
business_context: Used for data lineage, auditing, and understanding the freshness of data. Helps in tracking data ingestion processes, identifying potential delays, and ensuring data quality and governance.

name: updated_at
description: The timestamp indicating when this specific sales record was last modified or updated in the system.
business_context: Used for data auditing, tracking changes to sales records (e.g., post-sale adjustments, returns, corrections), and ensuring data accuracy and reconciliation. Important for maintaining data integrity and understanding data evolution.
